reviews.review_msg: I really enjoyed Sevda's class. She is the type of teacher to go above and beyond for her students. Much of the content I learned in class (ie. the research process) I have been applying to my full time job as a business analyst.  She really cares about her students and it shows. Hoping that she can continue to postively impact students!

Lots of ungraded pointless group work assignments. Time management was over the place: would give us too much breaks then have to rush through material towards the end. Midterm mentions concepts that were never taught. Need to know R/SPSS coding for this class. Participation counts towards 10%. Final exam was ok. Sevda was very nice + supportive.

Best professor I've had. Really structured and clear, balances content with practice using different approaches that keep you engaged so the course never feels heavy. She's also very nice, caring, funny, and approachable, and you can tell she genuinely loves what she does. She even helped me with a project unrelated to the course just because.10/10

Sevda was genuinely one of the best professors I ever had the pleasure of taking a class with! She is so helpful when it comes to understanding concepts and making sure all students understand. Very kind and cares about all her students! Also grades very fairly and makes class concepts so easy to understand.

Dr. Sattari is a caring, thoughtful professor. She constantly made sure to check on students, explain concepts clearly, and effectively hosted lectures by doing activities. Dr. Sattari is helpful, creates a positive class environment, and encourages questions when students are unsure or do not understand a concept. If you can, take BUS345 with her!

Sevda cares about her students and their success. She is very helpful, accommodating, and creates a welcoming, supportive, and engaging learning environment. Her lectures are always interesting and exciting, making the concepts easier to learn and understand.

Sevda is a great professor that really cares about her students. If you speak with her outside of lecture hours she is always willing to listen and share her thoughts as well. Listen to her instructions, follow her guidelines, lectures, attend class and participate and you will enjoy it.

Sevda was a great professor. She never rushed through the course material and ensured to cover each topic equally while giving supporting resources or assignments that can help to understand the concepts better. Grading and exams are fair considering you study enough and review the course materials.
Very helpful and approachable professor! She makes concepts fun and explains everything clearly and in a way that's easy to understand. Always supportive and open to questions.

As her TA, I had the chance to see firsthand how dedicated and supportive she is. She's very nice, extremely approachable, and always willing to help. She makes concepts fun and explains them clearly so students can truly understand the material.

Sevda explained course concepts in class very clearly, and the readings complemented her lectures. The group project took place over the course of the term with clear checkpoints, to ensure nobody falls behind. Her exams were extremely fair. She was very caring and willing to help whenever needed.

Sevda is very knowledgeable about each subject that is discussed in class and you can see the prep that goes into each lecture. She cares about her students success in the class, provides detailed instructions for each assignment and provides clear feedback.

Professor Sattari was really motivated to tailor her teaching style to the individual needs of students and actively worked to implement student feedback. Plenty of in-class activities and opportunities to ask questions. Overall amazing prof, really invested in the learning of her students!
Very helpful and approachable professor! She makes concepts fun and explains everything clearly and in a way that's easy to understand. Always supportive and open to questions.

As her TA, I had the chance to see firsthand how dedicated and supportive she is. She's very nice, extremely approachable, and always willing to help. She makes concepts fun and explains them clearly so students can truly understand the material.
